gui.starboundmc.task.contact.title: Reestablish Contact
gui.starboundmc.task.contact.guide: Reboot NOVA in Comms, confirm your identity and review the situation reports.
gui.starboundmc.task.contact.hint: Let us review the situation before deciding our next move.
gui.starboundmc.task.contact.archive: View objectives and rewards in Missions, or speak with NOVA in Comms. Your tracked mission appears in Overview.
gui.starboundmc.task.surface.title: First Surface Expedition
gui.starboundmc.task.surface.guide: Use the ship teleporter to reach the planet surface.
gui.starboundmc.task.surface.hint: Take your Matter Manipulator. The resources below will come in handy.
gui.starboundmc.task.surface.archive: Use the ship teleporter to travel to the surface and gather resources with the Matter Manipulator. Print an upgrade workbench using 50 voxels and its recipe materials.
gui.starboundmc.task.repair.title: Restore Sublight Travel
gui.starboundmc.task.repair.guide:
Collect diamonds using the mineral scan results and upgrade manipulator mining.
Print an ignition core, then insert it into the repair slot of the engine inside the ship to complete ignition.
gui.starboundmc.task.repair.hint: Once the core is ready, take your upgraded manipulator to the ship engine and install it.
gui.starboundmc.task.repair.archive: Printing an ignition core costs 3 diamonds and 50 voxels and takes 5 seconds. Carry a mining tier 1 Matter Manipulator when installing it in the ship engine repair slot. Ignition takes 3 seconds. The restored engine serves the whole crew.
gui.starboundmc.task.exploration.title: Another Sky
gui.starboundmc.task.exploration.guide: Choose a destination at the starmap console. Travel to a different planet type from your first recorded expedition, then teleport to its surface.
gui.starboundmc.task.exploration.hint: Check the destination environment and pack supplies before leaving.
gui.starboundmc.task.exploration.archive: Lush, barren, frozen and molten worlds have distinct surface environments. Check travel requirements at the starmap console, then use the teleporter to land after reaching orbit.
message.starboundmc.nova.task.surface.co: Surface arrival confirmed. A Matter Manipulator Module awaits at the terminal.
message.starboundmc.nova.task.repair.com: Sublight engine restored. We are ready to depart.
message.starboundmc.nova.task.exploratio: New expedition recorded. Your reward will be waiting when you return.
Focusing crystal assembly.
Insert into the ship engine to start ignition.

gui.starboundmc.engine.status.awaiting_c: Awaiting Sublight Ignition Core. Fabricate it at the voxel printer.
gui.starboundmc.engine.status.unsupporte: This module cannot repair the sublight engine. Module retained.

gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.subtitle: SHIPBOARD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.notice: Local interaction prototype. Story and ship state are not connected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.welcome: Shipboard interface online. Select a diagnostic prompt to test streaming text and terminal controls.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.id: I am N.O.V.A.: Navigation, Operations & Vessel Assistant. This prototype uses scripted local dialogue.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.pr: This cyan-white construct is a synthetic visual interface. Its eye brightness and projection stability indicate my current state.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.demo.response.st: The terminal is operating in local prototype mode. Story progression and shared ship state remain disconnected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.incompa: This world uses a newer story-state format. Update the mod before operating this terminal.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.first_c: Shipboard systems are back online. Your vital signs are stable. It is good to be in contact with you again.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.n: I am N.O.V.A.: Navigation, Operations & Vessel Assistant. I coordinate navigation, vessel operations, and onboard system monitoring.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.i: The ship encountered a high-intensity cosmic storm and was forced off its original course. Part of the navigation data was lost during the incident. I am still determining the exact cause.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.c: Our position is confirmed. Fortunately, we are currently in orbit around a habitable planet. Preliminary scans indicate a viable surface, with no immediate threats to life detected.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.topic.f: The propulsion systems are offline, and the ship cannot leave orbit under its own power. The teleporter remains operational; I recommend restoring the sublight engine first.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.landing: The teleporter is operating normally. Once you reach the surface, I will re-establish the communications link and continue analyzing the surrounding environment. For now, explore the surface and use the Matter Manipulator to gather basic resources.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.current: Current objective: use the ship teleporter to reach the planet surface. I will provide further environmental analysis and guidance after you arrive.
The initial surface expedition is complete. Continue gathering basic resources while I verify the sublight-engine repair plan.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.prologue.late_jo: Core systems are back online. I am compiling the ship's current status and the tasks available to you.
Sublight engine: damaged. In-system travel is unavailable.
Sublight engine: ignition sequence in progress.
Sublight engine: online. In-system travel is restored.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.status.hyperdriv: Hyperspace engine: damaged. Interstellar travel is unavailable.
Hyperspace engine: online. Interstellar travel is restored.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.status.mineral_s: Orbital mineral survey: awaiting surface resource data.
Orbital mineral survey: analyzing planetary strata.
Orbital mineral survey: complete; sparse diamond signatures detected in the deeper strata.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.repair.need_upgr: Upgrade your own Matter Manipulator to mining tier 1 at the printed upgrade workbench.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.repair.igniting: Sublight ignition in progress. The sequence will finish automatically.
gui.starboundmc.ship_ai.repair.complete: Sublight engine online. In-system travel is available; the hyperspace engine remains damaged.

message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.emerge: Warning: critical system failure detected. C▒ORE ST▓ATUS: #%/unreadable. Please reboot the core systems.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.locate: Communications remain unstable... locate the shipboard AI terminal and reboot the core systems.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.core_o: Core systems are back online. I am assessing the ship's overall status.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.first_: I have confirmed your arrival on the planet surface. The communications link is restored.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.matter: Explore the surrounding area and use the Matter Manipulator to gather basic resources. Hold right-click to activate the mining laser.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.wood_a: Good. You have acquired wood. It is a versatile basic resource; based on current data, your survival probability has increased by 17 percentage points.
message.starboundmc.nova.tutorial.voxel_: New usable resource detected: voxel. It is a standardized unit of matter and a common medium of exchange across settled space.

In material printing, base resources provide the primary substance while voxels complete the blueprint and construct precision structures that conventional processing cannot easily produce. With basic materials and a small amount of voxels, a printing station can fabricate complex components and tools.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.minera: Orbital scanners are online. Mineral survey in progress................
The preliminary scan is complete. Coal, copper, and iron are present in the upper strata; deeper layers also contain lapis lazuli, redstone, and sparse diamond deposits.
Diamond crystals can replace the damaged focusing array. Upgrade your Matter Manipulator to mining tier 1, print a Sublight Ignition Core, and insert it into the ship engine's module socket.
message.starboundmc.nova.prologue.sublig: Focusing array calibration accepted. Reactor ignition is beginning; sublight engine startup will complete automatically.
Sublight engine online. In-system navigation is restored. The hyperspace engine remains damaged.
command.starboundmc.debug.engine.all_res: Debug: sublight engine and hyperdrive restored.

gui.starboundmc.task.life_support.title: Prepare Life Support
gui.starboundmc.task.life_support.guide: Gather iron, copper, redstone, glass and Voxels on Lush. Print Basic Circuit Boards and an EPP Mk.I aboard the ship. Open the environment equipment screen with its key binding, equip the pack and refill inside the cabin.
gui.starboundmc.task.life_support.hint: Basic Circuit Boards power several entry-level devices. Equip your EPP and check its oxygen reserve.
gui.starboundmc.task.life_support.archiv: EPPs have a separate equipment slot. Oxygen stays with the device. Breathable environments stop consumption; the ship cabin refills the pack. Life support stations refill packs and canisters.
gui.starboundmc.task.lunar_sortie.title: First Airless Expedition
gui.starboundmc.task.lunar_sortie.guide: Equip an EPP with oxygen and visit Rocky Moon. Watch your reserve, explore, then return to the ship cabin with a working EPP. Print and fill canisters before departure; lunar supply caches may also hold oxygen.
gui.starboundmc.task.lunar_sortie.hint: Canisters take two seconds to use. Refill before danger arrives and keep a reserve for the return trip.
gui.starboundmc.task.lunar_sortie.archiv: A canister provides 180 oxygen units and leaves an empty container. Lunar outposts remain airless; full canisters in supply caches can extend your expedition.
message.starboundmc.nova.task.life_suppo: Life support is ready. Consider taking an emergency oxygen canister before visiting Rocky Moon.
message.starboundmc.nova.task.lunar_sort: Welcome back. Your first airless expedition is complete. Cabin life support will replenish your EPP.
